verdict.rationale: LM Studio's core function is downloading and running local LLMs (Llama, Qwen, gpt-oss) via search/download and CLI load commands, and community users confirm it 'just works' for downloading and running HuggingFace models. While the evidence pack never explicitly says 'GGUF', LM Studio is fundamentally a llama.cpp-based local model runner whose docs and CLI (`lms get`, `lms load`) describe exactly this workflow, and community feedback (comm-10, comm-12) confirms successful model loading/running.
